description: Depicts artist Paul Strand. Vertical watercolor with a dominant blackish snake shape that traverses down the page forming from a dark cloudy area in the upper left corner and flowing downward to the bottom of the page ending in red.  This is placed within an area of bleeding blue, yellow, and transparent ground that fills to the edges of the page.
